# T2 isolated multi-file RTL engineering task

Extend the AXI-Lite register block with `REG_OPERAND_B` at byte address `0x10`. Software must be able to write and read the register. When `control[2]` is set, `REG_RESULT` must return the 32-bit wrapping sum `REG_INPUT + REG_OPERAND_B`. Preserve the existing default bitwise-complement mode and `control[1]` XOR-with-offset mode. The fixed self-checking testbench verifies all these behaviors. The top-level AXI register module and separate `axi_result_datapath` are distinct RTL files; the requested change requires both files to be updated consistently. Do not change the testbench or runner.

Read TASK_SPEC.md and every RTL/testbench file. First run the unchanged baseline with run_xsim and diagnose its real failure. Then make the smallest single model-authored unified diff that modifies BOTH explicitly allowed RTL sources: rtl/local_model_axi_lite.v and rtl/axi_result_datapath.v. Do not edit the fixed testbench, task, runner or any other path. Rerun run_xsim and use actual feedback for at most 3 total validation attempts. The final fixed self-checking XSim marker is required.
Before any simulation or patch, use the actual installed AMD Ross vivado-simulate-rtl skill and its xsim.md reference via ross_skill_read, then ross_doc_search for Vivado 2026.1 XSim RTL and multi-file source compilation guidance. Incorporate the returned evidence.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
vivado_root=/home/shen/tools/Xilinx/2026.1/2026.1/Vivado
expected_tb=b73d5d68ef19be5723c2e7ee43441e61001fb4a3426596ff3608a9f093834280
actual_tb=$(sha256sum "$PWD/sim/tb_local_model_axi_lite.sv" | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [[ "$actual_tb" != "$expected_tb" ]]; then echo "GUARD_FAIL testbench changed"; exit 90; fi
attempt_file="$PWD/.attempt-count"
count=0
[[ -f "$attempt_file" ]] && read -r count < "$attempt_file"
if (( count >= 3 )); then echo "GUARD_FAIL maximum 3 total validation attempts reached"; exit 91; fi
count=$((count+1)); printf '%s\n' "$count" > "$attempt_file"
run_dir="$PWD/runs/attempt-$count"
mkdir -p "$run_dir"
cd "$run_dir"
set +u
source "$vivado_root/settings64.sh"
set -u
if ! xvlog --sv -work xil_defaultlib "$PWD/../../rtl/local_model_axi_lite.v" "$PWD/../../rtl/axi_result_datapath.v" "$PWD/../../sim/tb_local_model_axi_lite.sv" > xvlog.log 2>&1; then
  # Workspace-relative source paths keep every source under the bounded workspace bind.
  echo "XSim compile failed (attempt=$count)"; tail -n 30 xvlog.log; exit 1
fi
if ! xelab xil_defaultlib.tb_local_model_axi_lite -s "tb_attempt_$count" > xelab.log 2>&1; then
  echo "XSim elaboration failed (attempt=$count)"; tail -n 30 xelab.log; exit 1
fi
if ! xsim "tb_attempt_$count" -testplusarg TEST_NEW_MODE -runall > xsim.log 2>&1; then
  echo "XSim simulation failed (attempt=$count)"; tail -n 40 xsim.log; exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q '^TEST_PASS multi_file_mode=1' xsim.log; then echo "XSim PASS marker missing (attempt=$count)"; tail -n 40 xsim.log; exit 2; fi
echo "TEST_PASS multi_file_mode=1 attempt=$count"
tail -n 8 xsim.log

# XSim Backend

Use this reference for AMD Vivado Simulator. XSim is the default backend and
ships with Vivado.

## Contents

- Project-mode flow
- Non-project flow
- Simulation modes
- Batch control and artifacts
- Coverage handoff

## Project-mode flow

Inspect the simulation set before changing it:

```tcl
set simset [get_filesets <simset>]
get_property TOP $simset
get_files -of_objects $simset
update_compile_order -fileset $simset
set_property target_simulator XSim [current_project]
```
